extension.news: v0.92.0 - Native music in the API build: songs, albums and artists of a selected music library, one directory per album. - Songs are files in their album directory; a tag change re-imports one directory; a song leaves through its directory's listing. - Changed directories are scanned by name; the root is walked only when most changed. - The music scanner is held while the pass writes, so home widgets stay quiet. - Faster repair, pass and idle service on large catalogues; whole-library removal in one transaction. - Scans run one at a time (Kodi stops a running scan on the next request). - Fixed a freed InfoTag written on every listing (segfault in setGenres on 32-bit ARM). - Payloads are read on demand; listings and the pass no longer hold a library in memory. - An empty premiere or aired date is left out of the desired state. - Library update progress in the API build: a bar for enumeration, scans and the pass; Kodi's own scanning dialog for video. - Every movie's URL sits in a folder of its own; a change scans that folder alone. Deselect and reselect the Movies library after upgrading. - A music directory is never handed to Kodi incomplete: a store that cannot be read is answered by Kodi's own rows read back in full, or by waiting. - The pass finds songs Kodi lost (a stopped scan, an interrupted rescan) and re-imports their directory; an album change re-tags its songs. - A song played with no server date is last played on the day it was added, so recently played albums stay the server's. - A first import no longer re-writes every row it just imported. - Actor thumbnails obey the artwork cap; changing the cap now re-patches art. - Clean databases puts back the row Kodi needs, or the music window asked to rescan tags on every visit. - The pass reads back only what finds a row; the full row only for items whose state moved. - Items acknowledged before are acknowledged again without a compare. - Listed artwork asks the server for 1080-high JPEG by default (existing settings, now on); existing art re-caches once. - No state migrates between development builds; a profile from an earlier build needs a fresh native library. - A music directory Kodi skips after a stopped scan is salted so the next scan imports it. - An episode's art no longer carries the show's and season's keys, which Kodi derives itself.
